prompts.text:
Write one paragraph on the problem "Type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c of 71 mmol/mol (fictional)" from this draft.
Margaret Okafor, 58, seen for type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c of 71 mmol/mol on metformin; no follow-up booked. (Fictional.)

Write one paragraph on the problem "Metformin 1 g twice daily, continued (fictional)" from this draft.
Margaret Okafor, 58, seen for type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c of 71 mmol/mol on metformin; no follow-up booked. (Fictional.)

Write a short clinic letter from this draft and these problem paragraphs.
Margaret Okafor, 58, seen for type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c of 71 mmol/mol on metformin; no follow-up booked. (Fictional.)
## Problem list 1

Diabetes paragraph: HbA1c 71 mmol/mol.

## Problem list 2

Medication paragraph: metformin continued.

If the draft books a follow-up visit, the follow-up line goes after the first paragraph; otherwise nothing.

If so, write {{ macro.follow_up.content }} verbatim and nothing else at that place; do not write that content yourself — it is filled in afterward.
